The club was founded as '''FM Spyris Kaunas''' in 2004, became the section of [[BC Žalgiris]], and moved to their current stadium [[Darius and Girėnas Stadium]] in 2015. After their debut season in the A Lyga, the club adopted the name FK Kauno Žalgiris in 2016. [[Betsson]] has been the main sponsor of FK Kauno Žalgiris since 2022, the partnership was renewed in July 2025 through 2027.{{Cite web |date=2025-07-09 |title=Betsson Lithuania Extends Sponsorships with FK Žalgiris and Lithuanian Basketball Federation Until 2027 - Betsson Group |url=https://betssongroup.com/news/lithuania_sponsorship_extensions/ |access-date=2026-04-21 |website=Betsson |language=en-GB}}"}}
